title: Retire .deb and .snap targets; AppImage is the sole Linux distribution
decision: Remove the .deb and .snap targets from electron-builder's linux.target list, drop the deb.depends / deb.afterInstall / snap config blocks, delete the now-orphaned build/after-install.sh script, and remove the dist:deb / dist:snap npm scripts. Switchboard on Linux is distributed only as a Switchboard-<version>.AppImage from this release forward. Desktop integration for AppImage users is handled by the app itself on first launch (see DEC-000005).

context.task_description: rc.11 (DEC-000005) shipped AppImage self-install of the .desktop entry and hicolor icons, plus a Preferences uninstall action. Live-verified on Ubuntu 24.04 GNOME (Wayland) 2026-07-31: manual and in-app uninstall behave identically; re-launching restores the integration. This removes the last user-facing reason to prefer .deb over AppImage.
assumptions: Users prefer one packaging format across distros (established in the DEC-000005 conversation)
AppImage + self-install is a durable pattern (used by appimaged, AppImageUpdate, and many packaged tools)
Future distros (Fedora, Arch, RHEL, immutable variants) get first-class support via the same AppImage rather than per-distro packages

options.label: Drop .deb and .snap now that AppImage self-installs (chosen)
options.description: Single format; single maintenance surface; consistent desktop integration path across distros.

options.label: Keep .deb as a fallback and drop only .snap
options.description: Retains distro-native install for Debian/Ubuntu users but forces us to maintain two integration paths and two release artifacts, and users still have to make a distribution choice. Rejected: the user explicitly asked for one mechanism.

options.label: Keep all three targets
options.description: Status quo before rc.12; multiplies build/verification surface and gives users a choice they do not want.

rationale: DEC-000005 committed AppImage as the single mechanism once its desktop integration was verified. Verification is complete (rc.11 on Ubuntu 24.04 Wayland: dock icon, app grid, and Preferences uninstall all work; manual uninstall matches the in-app path exactly). Continuing to ship .deb + .snap after that verification would maintain two extra release artifacts and force us to keep multi-format testing forever, in exchange for no user benefit.

risk.rollback: Restore package.json linux.target entries, deb + snap config blocks, dist:deb / dist:snap scripts, and build/after-install.sh from history. No code changes required outside packaging config.

outcome.notes: rc.12 in flight. Verification: dist:appimage still produces a working AppImage; dist:deb and dist:snap scripts absent from package.json.
